title: Palak paneer
steps: Blanch the spinach for 2 minutes, then plunge into cold water and blend smooth with the green chillies.
Heat oil, crackle the cumin, then sauté chopped onion, ginger and garlic until golden.
Add chopped tomatoes and cook down until jammy.
Stir in the spinach purée and simmer for 5 minutes; season with salt and garam masala.
Fold in cubed paneer and a swirl of cream. Warm through and serve with roti or rice.

title: Paneer bhurji
steps: Crumble the paneer with your fingers.
Sauté chopped onion and green chilli in oil until soft.
Add chopped tomato, turmeric and salt; cook for 3 minutes.
Tip in the paneer, toss for 2 minutes and finish with coriander. Great in a roll or with toast.

title: Tomato rice
steps: Rinse the rice and soak for 10 minutes.
Crackle mustard seeds and curry leaves in oil, then add sliced onion.
Add chopped tomatoes, turmeric, chilli powder and salt; cook until soft.
Stir in rice and water, cover and cook on low for 12 minutes. Rest 5 minutes and fluff.

title: Egg bhurji
steps: Sauté onion and green chilli in oil or butter.
Add tomato, turmeric and salt; cook for 2 minutes.
Pour in beaten eggs and scramble gently over low heat.
Finish with coriander; serve with pav or toast.

title: Dal tadka
steps: Pressure-cook the dal with turmeric, salt and water for 3 whistles.
In a pan, heat ghee and crackle cumin; add garlic, onion and chilli.
Add tomato and cook until soft.
Pour the tadka over the dal, simmer for 5 minutes and adjust the thickness with water.

title: Aloo paratha
steps: Knead the atta with water and a pinch of salt into a soft dough; rest 15 minutes.
Boil and mash the potatoes with chilli, coriander, cumin and salt.
Stuff a ball of dough with the filling, seal and roll out gently.
Cook on a hot tawa with a little oil or butter until golden on both sides.

title: Spinach & mushroom frittata
steps: Heat the grill. Sauté onion and mushrooms in an ovenproof pan.
Add spinach and wilt for a minute.
Pour in eggs beaten with salt and pepper; cook on low until the edges set.
Top with cheese and grill for 3–4 minutes until puffed and golden.

title: Bombay grilled sandwich
steps: Butter the bread and spread chutney if you have it.
Layer sliced cucumber, tomato and cheese; season with salt.
Grill or toast in a pan until crisp and golden. Slice and serve hot.

title: Chicken & pepper stir-fry
steps: Slice chicken into strips and season lightly.
Stir-fry over high heat until browned; set aside.
Fry garlic, onion and capsicum for 2 minutes so they stay crunchy.
Return chicken, add soy and chilli sauce, toss and finish with spring onions.

title: Creamy mushroom pasta
steps: Boil pasta in salted water until al dente; save a cup of pasta water.
Brown sliced mushrooms in oil, then add garlic.
Pour in cream and simmer until slightly thick.
Toss in pasta with a splash of pasta water; finish with pepper and parmesan.

title: Pav bhaji
steps: Boil potatoes and peas; mash roughly.
Melt butter, cook onion and capsicum, then tomatoes until mushy.
Add the mash, spices and a little water; mash together and simmer 10 minutes.
Toast buttered pav on the pan. Serve with onion and a squeeze of lemon.

title: Home-style chicken curry
steps: Marinate chicken in curd, salt and chilli powder for 15 minutes.
Fry onions until deep golden, then add ginger-garlic paste.
Add tomatoes and cook until the oil separates.
Add chicken, sear for 5 minutes, then simmer covered with water for 20 minutes. Finish with garam masala.

title: Cucumber raita
steps: Grate the cucumber and squeeze out excess water.
Whisk the curd smooth with salt.
Stir in cucumber, roasted cumin and chopped mint. Chill until serving.

title: Kadai paneer
steps: Dry-roast and crush coriander seeds and chillies (or use powder).
Sauté diced onion and capsicum on high heat; keep them crunchy.
Add tomato and ginger and cook to a thick masala.
Toss in paneer cubes and kasuri methi; cook for 3 minutes.

title: Mushroom masala
steps: Sauté onion and ginger until golden.
Add tomatoes and spices; cook until thick.
Add sliced mushrooms and cook for 8 minutes until they release their water.
Finish with a spoon of cream.

title: Banana smoothie
steps: Peel and slice the bananas.
Blend with milk, curd and honey until smooth.
Pour over ice and drink straight away.

title: Masala omelette
steps: Beat eggs with finely chopped onion, chilli, tomato, coriander and salt.
Heat oil in a pan and pour in the eggs.
Cook on medium until set underneath, flip and cook 30 seconds more.

title: Aloo matar
steps: Crackle cumin in oil and fry onion until soft.
Add tomato and spices and cook into a masala.
Add cubed potato, peas and water; cover and cook 15 minutes until tender.

title: Prawn masala
steps: Thaw prawns and toss with salt and chilli powder.
Fry onion, garlic and curry leaves until golden.
Add tomato and cook until soft; stir in coconut milk if using.
Add prawns and simmer 4–5 minutes until just pink.

title: Veg fried rice
steps: Use day-old cooked rice, or cook and cool rice first.
Stir-fry diced carrot, capsicum and peas on high heat.
Add rice and soy sauce and toss until every grain is coated.
Finish with spring onions.

title: Roasted tomato soup
steps: Roughly chop tomatoes, onion and garlic.
Cook in butter for 5 minutes, then add water and simmer 15 minutes.
Blend until smooth; season with salt and pepper.
Swirl in cream and serve with toast.

title: French toast
steps: Whisk eggs and milk with a pinch of salt (or sugar).
Dip bread slices in the mix for a few seconds each side.
Fry in butter until golden. Serve with banana and honey.

title: Dal palak
steps: Pressure-cook dal with turmeric and water.
Wash and chop the spinach.
Fry garlic and cumin in ghee, add tomato, then spinach until wilted.
Stir into the dal and simmer 5 minutes.

title: Chicken salad wrap
steps: Season and pan-fry the chicken; slice thinly.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan.
Spread mayo, layer lettuce, tomato, cucumber and chicken.
Roll up tightly and slice in half.

title: Pasta arrabbiata
steps: Boil the pasta in well-salted water.
Gently fry sliced garlic and chilli flakes in oil.
Add chopped tomatoes and simmer into a quick sauce.
Toss the pasta through with a splash of pasta water and basil.

title: Garlic mushroom toast
steps: Toast the bread.
Melt butter and fry sliced mushrooms until golden.
Add garlic, salt and pepper and cook 1 minute more.
Pile onto toast and scatter with herbs.

title: Curd rice
steps: Cook rice until soft and let it cool slightly; mash lightly.
Mix in curd and salt (add a little milk if too sour).
Temper mustard seeds, curry leaves and chilli in oil and pour over.
Fold in grated cucumber and serve cool.

title: Kachumber salad
steps: Finely dice cucumber, tomato and onion.
Toss with lemon juice, salt and chopped chilli.
Finish with coriander and serve right away.

title: Chicken biryani
steps: Marinate chicken in curd, ginger-garlic, spices and salt for 30 minutes.
Fry sliced onions until deep brown; keep half for garnish.
Cook the chicken with tomato and remaining onions for 10 minutes.
Layer par-boiled rice over the chicken, add mint, fried onions and ghee.
Cover tightly and cook on very low heat for 20 minutes.

title: Paneer tikka
steps: Whisk curd with spices, lemon, oil and salt.
Toss paneer, capsicum and onion chunks in the marinade; rest 15 minutes.
Thread onto skewers or spread on a tray.
Grill or pan-roast on high heat until charred at the edges.

title: Shakshuka
steps: Soften onion, capsicum and garlic in oil.
Add chopped tomatoes and chilli; simmer into a thick sauce.
Make wells and crack in the eggs.
Cover and cook until the whites set. Serve with bread.

title: Veg hakka noodles
steps: Boil noodles until just done, drain and toss with a little oil.
Stir-fry shredded cabbage, capsicum and carrot on high heat.
Add noodles, soy, vinegar and chilli sauce. Toss well and finish with spring onions.

title: Mango lassi
steps: Peel and chop the mango.
Blend with curd, milk and sugar until frothy.
Serve chilled.

title: Momos with tomato chutney
steps: Steam the momos for 10–12 minutes.
Char the tomatoes and garlic in a dry pan.
Blend with chilli and salt into a spicy chutney.
Serve the momos hot with the chutney.

title: Gajar halwa
steps: Grate the carrots.
Simmer in milk, stirring often, until the milk is absorbed.
Add sugar and ghee and cook until glossy.
Garnish with fried cashews and raisins.

title: Spaghetti aglio e olio
steps: Cook spaghetti in well-salted water.
Gently fry thinly sliced garlic and chilli in olive oil until pale gold.
Toss in the pasta with a splash of pasta water.
Finish with parmesan if you like.

title: Kanda poha
steps: Rinse poha in a sieve and let it soften.
Fry peanuts, then onion, potato, curry leaves and chilli.
Add turmeric and salt, then the poha; toss gently.
Steam covered for 2 minutes and finish with lemon juice.

title: Vegetable upma
steps: Dry-roast the rava until fragrant; set aside.
Temper mustard seeds and curry leaves, add onion, chilli and vegetables.
Add water and salt and bring to a boil.
Stir in rava steadily to avoid lumps; cover and cook 2 minutes.

title: Chole
steps: Soak chickpeas overnight; pressure-cook with salt (and a tea bag for colour).
Fry onion, ginger and garlic until golden.
Add tomato and spices and cook to a thick masala.
Add chickpeas with some cooking water and simmer 15 minutes.

title: Lemon rice
steps: Spread cooked rice on a plate to cool.
Fry peanuts, mustard seeds, curry leaves and chilli in oil.
Add turmeric, then the rice and salt.
Squeeze over lemon juice and toss gently.

title: Berry overnight oats
steps: Stir oats with milk and curd in a jar.
Top with frozen berries and a drizzle of honey.
Refrigerate overnight; eat cold.

title: Peas & carrot pulao
steps: Rinse and soak rice for 15 minutes.
Fry bay leaf, cumin and sliced onion in ghee.
Add peas, diced carrot, rice, water and salt.
Cover and cook on low for 12 minutes; rest before fluffing.
